'''Gost''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who served as a member of the [[Tythan military]]. In [[25,793 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Fury Station]] in orbit of [[Furies Gate]] during the first contact of the Tythans with a ship coming out of their system.
